description: Eight synthetic facts with independent capture prompts, training query phrasings, and held-out query phrasings.

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: Vessel ORBIT-17 has a calibration temperature of 42 degrees Celsius.
train_queries: What calibration temperature was recorded for vessel ORBIT-17?
For ORBIT-17, what temperature should the calibration record show?
heldout_queries: Tell me the recorded calibration temperature belonging to ORBIT-17.
Which temperature is associated with the ORBIT-17 vessel calibration?

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: Vessel NOVA-22 has a calibration temperature of 18 degrees Celsius.
train_queries: What calibration temperature was recorded for vessel NOVA-22?
For NOVA-22, what temperature should the calibration record show?
heldout_queries: Tell me the recorded calibration temperature belonging to NOVA-22.
Which temperature is associated with the NOVA-22 vessel calibration?

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: The blue instrument was manufactured in 2031.
train_queries: In what year was the blue instrument manufactured?
What is the manufacturing year of the blue instrument?
heldout_queries: When did production of the blue instrument take place?
Give me the year associated with the blue instrument's manufacture.

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: The red rover is named Kestrel.
train_queries: What is the name of the red rover?
Which name belongs to the red rover?
heldout_queries: Identify the rover that is red.
What do we call the red rover?

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: Sensor G-14 is installed in the eastern greenhouse.
heldout_queries: Find the installation location for G-14.
In which greenhouse area can I find sensor G-14?

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: The amber drone has a battery capacity of 640 watt-hours.
train_queries: What is the battery capacity of the amber drone?
How many watt-hours can the amber drone's battery store?
heldout_queries: State the energy capacity of the amber drone battery.
How large is the amber drone's battery, measured in watt-hours?

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: Archive Delta contains 275 catalogued entries.
train_queries: How many catalogued entries are in Archive Delta?
What is the entry count for Archive Delta?
heldout_queries: Give the number of records catalogued in Archive Delta.
How many items does Archive Delta contain in its catalogue?

facts.capture_prompt: Remember this fact: Station Lyra opened in 2044.
train_queries: What year was Station Lyra opened?
heldout_queries: In which year did Station Lyra begin operating?
Tell me the opening year of Station Lyra.
